sources.entry: Sync-in - File storage, syncing, sharing, and collaboration with real-time editing, permission management, and desktop/CLI clients. (Demo, Source Code, Clients) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: Sync-in Desktop & CLI is a client for Sync-in servers that provides local file synchronization on Windows, macOS, and Linux plus a command-line tool for automation.
summary.what_it_does: The project offers a desktop application that keeps local folders synchronized with one or more Sync-in servers, using one-way or two-way workflows. It includes a checksum-based sync mode for stronger integrity checks and a metadata-based mode for lighter syncs. Users can schedule recurring syncs, set include and exclude filters, and preview operations before applying them. A CLI supports scripting, cron jobs, CI/CD pipelines, and headless environments, and authentication follows Sync-in Server identity flows. The README also lists a transfer manager, real-time monitoring and logs, a setup wizard, and automatic background updates.
use_cases: keep local folders synced with a Sync-in server
one-way or two-way file synchronization across workstations
scheduled backups or syncs via cron jobs
command-line file transfer in CI/CD pipelines
preview sync changes before applying them
notable: Sync preview to simulate operations before changes
CLI designed for cron, CI/CD, and headless use
Authentication compatible with Sync-in Server identity flows
caveats: README does not include install or run instructions, so setup details must come from the documentation
Client is designed to work with a Sync-in server; it is not a standalone file store
